archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / DEEP INDIGO SAAS (Enterprise Operations Platform)

brand_identity.name: GlowMeOut Admin
brand_identity.description: Enterprise-grade operations and service provider lifecycle management platform for GlowMeOut beauty & wellness ecosystem. Engineered for mission-critical operations, partner verification, customer support, automated billing, and detailed audit trails.
brand_identity.tone: Authoritative, crisp, operational, data-dense, distraction-free neutral UI with precision deep indigo/navy accent

entry_surfaces./: split dashboard — dark navy collapsible operations sidebar left, white card content area with KPI metric strip and dense operational requests grid right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — deep indigo positioning and security assurance panel left, white admin credentials form card right

layout_and_grids.structure: Fixed/collapsible left sidebar (240px expanded, 68px collapsed) + Sticky topbar (56px) + Scrollable main content viewport with max-width containment
layout_and_grids.sidebar_behavior: Collapsible with icon-only tooltip mode on collapse, clear active indicator (left accent bar + high contrast text), grouped navigation items with subtle category labels
topbar_elements: Dynamic Breadcrumb navigation (/ Section / Resource / Sub-view)
Global search input (with keyboard shortcut `Cmd+K` hint)
Notification bell with pending review counter badge
Admin profile dropdown (Name, Role, Status, Sign Out)
layout_and_grids.page_header_pattern: Flex justify-between items-center mb-5 pb-3 border-b border-slate-200. Left: Page title with record count pill 'Available Records (524)' + subtitle. Right: Action buttons (Export CSV, Add New, Batch Operations).
layout_and_grids.table_control_toolbar: Container bar above tables: Left has Search input + Status Filter tabs/dropdown + Saved Views selector. Right has Column visibility dropdown + Density toggle (Compact/Standard) + Refresh button.
layout_and_grids.bulk_action_bar: Sticky bottom or floating animated pill when >=1 rows checked: displays count '{N} selected', Select All, Batch Approve, Batch Reject, Export Selected, Clear Selection buttons.

table_design_system.philosophy: Enterprise logistics & operations density. Crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0), no visual fluff. Right-aligned numbers, left-aligned text, centered status badges.
table_design_system.header_styling: bg-slate-100/90 text-slate-700 font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider select-none border-b border-slate-300 px-3 py-2.5
table_design_system.sorting_affordance: Double-arrow icon for unsorted columns, up/down blue highlight arrow for active sort
table_design_system.pagination_bar: Flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white text-xs text-slate-600. Left: 'Showing 1 to 25 of 524 entries' + Page size select dropdown (10, 25, 50, 100). Right: Numbered pagination buttons [Prev, 1, 2, 3 ... 21, Next].

partner_verification_workspace.layout: Two-column operational split view (70% main workspace + 30% sticky decision sidebar)
left_main_sections: Uploaded Documents table (Government ID, Cosmetology License, Insurance Certificate, Background Check) with interactive Preview modal and per-document status tags (Pending, Under Review, Verified, Rejected)
right_decision_sidebar: Compliance Checklist (Interactive checks for ID, License, Address verification)
Admin Notes & Audit Timeline (Chronological log with timestamps)

Action Toolbar with distinct high-contrast controls: 'Approve Partner' (solid green), 'Request Correction' (amber outline with reason modal), 'Reject Application' (destructive red with reason selector)

motion.table_batch_bar: Slide up from bottom with spring transition

accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant (All text > 4.5:1 against surface)
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab navigation through table rows, Esc to close modals/sheets, Enter to open row detail
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, table headers, checkboxes, pagination controls, status badges) must provide kebab-case data-testid tags

admin_avatar.description: Executive portrait for primary admin user profile

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly avoid consumer beauty styling (no excessive hot pinks, pastel gradients, or glitter decorations). This is an enterprise operations console.
Use Manrope Variable for clean, modern sans-serif readability and IBM Plex Mono for IDs, currencies, dates, and tabular numbers.

Every table MUST have: Search toolbar, Filter dropdowns, Column sorting (with ascending/descending state), Bulk checkbox selection + Bulk action bar, Status badges, and Numbered pagination with page-size selector.
Implement real backend routes for seeded items with persistence so Approve/Reject, status changes, and filter queries work seamlessly.
Always include comprehensive data-testid attributes on buttons, links, inputs, and table rows for robust automated testing.
Keep contrast ratios high: Dark slate (#0F172A) on light gray (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF) surfaces.
